protocol.included: request planning, allocation, reads, decode, interpolation, final CUDA download when selected
protocol.excluded: normalization, augmentation, setup, warmup, validation, destruction, cache clearing
protocol.sampling: TensorStore/zarr read an enclosing ROI then SciPy order=1 samples matched float32 coordinates; vc_reader samples chunks natively
protocol.batching: ML: one vc_reader read_many call, concurrent TensorStore futures, zarr thread-pool reads; no pre-stacking
protocol.order: cyclic rotation of backend order each repetition
protocol.caches: warm OS cache; vc_reader/TensorStore use requested decoded-cache budgets; zarr has no added decoded cache
protocol.endpoints: all outputs on host except when --cuda-output=device
protocol.throughput: output voxels/bytes, not bytes fetched from storage
protocol.speedup: baseline p50 / vc_reader p50; >1 means vc_reader is faster

surface.preparation: bilinear coordinate-field interpolation; excludes TIFF loading and geometry preparation from timings
